entries.reason: A derived value. An element holds facts, not calculations.
entries.hint: Ask the question in an analytics package, over the bite time and arrival time fields.

entries.reason: A calculated expression is code-like text. CCIS packages are data only and nothing is run.

defaultsApplied: Every field carries all six data states, because CCIS requires them. The form does not state them.
Every field has source class imported. The form does not say who entered a value.
Setting, population and exclusions are marked as not stated. The form does not give them.
No relationships between fields are inferred. The form declares none.
limits: One-way only: no round trip back to FHIR is claimed.
No real terminology is resolved: coded answers point at the local demonstration value sets only, and the extension urls are synthetic stand-ins.

The converted element is unreviewed and draft. A valid Questionnaire does not make a valid CCIS element (REQ-092), so the element is checked against the element schema, and validator layers 1 to 8 still apply.
